summary: Iteration 18: Company Portal Improvements Testing - All major features working. Date filters, clickable prescribers in dashboard/tabs, prescriber detail page, agencies with assignment UX all functional. Fixed missing router hook in CompanyAgences component.

issues: React Native Web deprecation warnings: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' and 'shadow* style props are deprecated'

context_for_next_testing_agent: Company portal improvements are complete. Features tested: 1) Date filter buttons (Tout/7 jours/30 jours) on dashboard work, 2) Top prescribers in dashboard are clickable and navigate to /company-prescriber-detail, 3) Prescripteurs tab shows searchable list with clickable items, 4) Agences tab shows agencies with prescribers, 'Gerer les prescripteurs' button always visible, prescribers clickable, 5) Prescriptions tab shows 'En cours'/'Validees' tabs, 6) Prescriber detail page shows identity card, stats, agency info, and prescriptions list. Fixed bug: added missing 'const router = useRouter()' in CompanyAgences function.
